verdict.rationale: Mem0 documents filtered search ("semantic and filtered search capabilities") and entity-scoped filters (user/agent/app/session) as well as a reranking feature ("Advanced Retrieval" reorders results using deep semantic understanding), giving developers more than one retrieval knob. However, there is no explicit mention of a keyword or hybrid search mode, and no independent/hands-on evidence validating how well these filters or reranking actually change recall quality in practice. Missing for 10: documented keyword/hybrid search option, independent verification of filter/rerank effectiveness.
